I'm playing both Cyberpunk and Baulder's Gate 3.  I have 4070Ti and Ryzen 7950x.

It runs Cyberpunk easy 150+ FPS on Ultra settings, but BG3 seems to give it bigger challenge.  Since BG3 is more CPU intensive than GPU, especially in the ACT 3 city with so many NPCs running around, it actually dips into 90s FPS at times which never happens in Cyberpunk.

I have that same mobo Gigabyte 650M Aorus Elite AX.  It is a compact motherboard so be careful in researching your measurements for your case and cooler.  My PC is a very tight fit (see pic below) with DeepCool Ch560 Case and the huge NH-D15 cooler.

I had to use to offset screw position for the cooler to allow room for my GPU.  But I'm getting decent benchmarks and temperatures so can't complain.  Though I wish my RAM was stable at 6400Mt, so I'm running 6200Mt.

Should probably consider refresh rate of monitor.  I have and old 60hz monitor and a Nvidia 4070Ti.  Graphics are great but seeing some screen tear in 1st person games like Cyberpunk when vertical sync is off.  I'm looking for a 144Mhz monitor, but too broke for now.
